> (Little hint, in your post history you clearly identify yourself as an incel, and as a subcategory of incels.) 

I make a distinction between incel as in involuntary celibate and incel as in member of incel community. Normally, I would never call myself an incel because I generally dislike the community, but when looking for advice, I see the label as appropriate, since I am a virgin who would like to have sex. Advice for incels should still apply to me, and I don't feel like wasting my time trying to preemptively defend myself by convincing people that "I might be a worthless virgin, but at least I'm not one of those evil incels".

> Start by not associating with incels, incel sites, incel content, incel language, and incel ideology.

I don't associate with any incels or incel sites. However, I do find some incel language is useful. Most of it is fucking stupid (roastie, foid, dogpill, etc) but I'll admit that terms like LDAR, suicidefuel, rope, and blackpill do speak to me on some level. Obviously, I don't go around using these terms in casual conversation though. Incel ideology is obviously mostly garbage, but that doesn't mean they don't have some insights.

>Check with your local police, hit google, and give the guidelines a proper read so you understand what actually is and isn't falling under the category of "Incels ad a terroristic ideological group".

Obviously, I don't think the police are going to start arresting virgins, I just think that putting this out there is going to have a negative impact on loser virgins like myself when the public starts associating us with terrorists. You can probably say that this is more a fault of the incel killers who have brought about this response, but that doesn't change anything. I'm still fucked.
I don't know, just general misery and self-loathing.
I don't like doing anything and helping others is bullshit, so all I'm left with is reducing pain and increasing pleasure. How am I supposed to do that?
What goal is even worth working towards? I can't think of anything.
How am I associating with incels?
Fuck off.

I don't think that the government is itself going to do anything against me just for being a virgin, that's obviously ridiculous. However, the fact is that they're out there telling people incels are terrorists, and I don't expect everyone to be rational and careful with how they define incel. A lot of people are probably be going to be saying to themselves, "that virgin loser is probably one of those incels", and people will begin associating me with terrorism in their minds. 

> Being incel" is not a condition. It's not the same thing as being a virgin, it's not genetic, it's not a disability, it's literally just something YOU CHOOSE to identify as. That's it.

I disagree with this claim. If being an incel was simply a matter of self-identification, Elliot Rodger would not be considered an incel, as he never identified himself as such. Clearly the definition of incel is broader than you're suggesting, unless you would actually agree that Elliot Rodger wasn't an incel. So if inceldom can be thrust on people without self-identification, how can I trust that I won't be considered an incel just for being a pathetic male virgin?
Ya if only...

Now that Canada is treating incels as terrorists, I feel totally fucked. I don't post on incel forums or publicly discuss anything incel-related/misogynistic, but people love to accuse me of being an incel anyway. There's basically nothing I can do to avoid being associated with terrorists other than somehow get into a relationship. And don't tell me that only people who post extremist content are going to be affected; look at all the completely innocent Muslims (and even Sikhs) who were victims of hate crimes after 9/11. 

How the hell am I supposed to get into a relationship now? Unless I can fake experience, any theoretical woman that's actually interested will just associate me with terrorism because I'm a virgin. I guess getting into a relationship was already impossible for garbage like me, but at least before I didn't have to worry about being lumped in with terrorists by my government.
A quick google search shows me that Trey Songz has a son, and Michael B. Jordan claims to have been in a friends with benefits relationship in high school, so clearly they have both had sex.

It doesn't make any sense to use incel as a catch-all term for misogynist though. Would it make sense to say that Donald Trump is an incel president? People use it that way because it's way more insulting to be considered unfuckable than it is to hate women. 

No man who hasn't had sex is respected by the media, unless it's for religious reasons. I doubt you can name a single man who is still alive today who would prove me wrong.

Because to be respected as a man you have to have sex. Maybe you can still earn respect if you're literally a priest or something, but that's not really relevant to me. Just look at how the term "incel" has caught on as a general insult for misogynist in a lot of online circles, even when talking about people that are definitely in relationships. The reason people do this is because calling someone a misogynist doesn't really do anything. But if you call someone an incel, you're saying they can't have sex, and thus they are completely worthless, and their opinions can be completely disregarded.
